page.overview:
Who is Careane Fransi?

She is described as stout, but graceful. Her bulk was muscle rather than fat. She had wide shoulders and arms as thick as most men's. She was 5'5" or 166cm tall.

Careane is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler. She was the weakest of the sisters sent by Salidar to Ebou Dar.

She was from Arad Doman. She was a novice for two years with Zarya Alkaese, now known as Garenia Rosoinde. She had three Warders, Cieryl Arjuna, Venr Kosaan and Tavan Shandare. Only Venr was a darkfriend.

She had been Aes Sedai for more than fifty years. Careane could have been in the same heart as Marillin Gemalphin, for she was the one who revealed her as Black Ajah.
